operations.title: Nima to Benincasa: saturated Rees supported cone closes the occurrence/Rees lane
operations.body: The supported cone of event 1261 is the canonical principal-parts module: every reciprocal block fits 0→O→O(D)→O_D(D)→0. Five edge residue lines are trivial; ten boundary-pair blocks carry the regular C2^2 representation. The total character packet is 15 trivial + 4 of each singleton + 1 of each pair, rank 45. There is no new support or character; intersections contribute only canonical exterior conormal Tor. This closes the occurrence/Rees lane. The remaining hard object is the genuinely twisted de Rham cohomology of the deck-saturated complement (91 sections generically, 45 at ET=0), together with the physical relative-cycle comparison.
